arxiv-1405-3500.creator: Alexander L. SAKHNOVICH
arxiv-1405-3500.description: Abstract Two important cases, where boundary conditions and solutions of the well-known integrable equations on a semi-strip are uniquely determined by the initial conditions, are rigorously studied in detail. First, the case of rectangular matrix solutions of the defocusing nonlinear Schrödinger equation with quasi-analytic boundary conditions is dealt with. (The result is new even for a scalar nonlinear Schrödinger equation.

arxiv-2208-11172.description: Abstract In the parallel processing field, graph embedding is motivated by simulation interconnection networks to another. The quadtree is an important technique used to present spatial data and is used in many application domains, especially computer vision and image processing. Researchers are interested in the construction and manipulation of quadtrees on parallel machines.

arxiv-2211-02923.title: Cross-Subject Emotion Recognition with Sparsely-Labeled Peripheral Physiological Data Using SHAP-Explained Tree Ensembles
arxiv-2211-02923.creator: Feng Zhou, Tao Chen, Baiying Lei
arxiv-2211-02923.description: Abstract There are still many challenges of emotion recognition using physiological data despite the substantial progress made recently. In this paper, we attempted to address two major challenges. First, in order to deal with the sparsely-labeled physiological data, we first decomposed the raw physiological data using signal spectrum analysis, based on which we extracted both complexity and energy features.

arxiv-2302-00832.title: Inform the uninformed: Improving Online Informed Consent Reading with an AI-Powered Chatbot Conference: Proceedings of the 2023 CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems; April 23–28, 2023; Hamburg, Germany Proceedings of the 2023 CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems (CHI
arxiv-2302-00832.creator: Ziang Xiao, Tiffany Wenting Li, Karrie Karahalios, Hari Sundaram
arxiv-2302-00832.description: Abstract . Informed consent is a core cornerstone of ethics in human subject research. Through the informed consent process, participants learn about the study procedure, benefits, risks, and more to make an informed decision. However, recent studies showed that current practices might lead to uninformed decisions and expose participants to unknown risks, especially in online studies.

arxiv-2310-17914.title: 3D-Aware Visual Question Answering about Parts, Poses and Occlusions
arxiv-2310-17914.creator: Xingrui Wang Wufei Ma Zhuowan Li Adam Kortylewski Alan Yuille
arxiv-2310-17914.description: Abstract Despite rapid progress in Visual question answering ( VQA ), existing datasets and models mainly focus on testing reasoning in 2D. However, it is important that VQA models also understand the 3D structure of visual scenes, for example to support tasks like navigation or manipulation. This includes an understanding of the 3D object pose, their parts and occlusions.

arxiv-2407-05374.title: Multimodal Prompt Learning with Missing Modalities for Sentiment Analysis and Emotion Recognition
arxiv-2407-05374.creator: Zirun Guo, Tao Jin, Zhou Zhao
arxiv-2407-05374.description: Abstract The development of multimodal models has significantly advanced multimodal sentiment analysis and emotion recognition. However, in real-world applications, the presence of various missing modality cases often leads to a degradation in the model’s performance. In this work, we propose a novel multimodal Transformer framework using prompt learning to address the issue of missing modalities.

arxiv-2504-10543.title: Entanglement induced by quantum gravity in an infinite square well
arxiv-2504-10543.creator: Chi Zhang, Fu-Wen Shu
arxiv-2504-10543.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Chi Zhang, Fu-Wen Shu. In this work, we examine the entanglement dynamics of two massive particles confined within their respective infinite square potential wells induced by gravity. Assuming that each particle is initially in the ground state of its infinite square well, we investigate the formation of entanglement between the particles as a result of their gravitational interaction during their adiabatic movement towards each other. Our results reveal that, under suitable parameters, entanglement swiftly emerges.

arxiv-2506-23415.title: The effect of droplet configurations within the Functional Renormalization Group of low-dimensional Ising models
arxiv-2506-23415.creator: Ivan Balog, Lucija Nora Farkaš, Maroje Marohnić, Gilles Tarjus
arxiv-2506-23415.description: Abstract We explore the application of the nonperturbative functional renormalization group (NPFRG) within its most common approximation scheme based on truncations of the derivative expansion to the Z 2 Z_{2} -symmetric scalar φ 4 \varphi^{4} theory as the lower critical dimension d lc d_{\rm lc} is approached.

arxiv-2508-19276.title: Quantum Resource Management in the NISQ Era: Challenges, Vision, and a Runtime Framework
arxiv-2508-19276.creator: 1 st Marcos Guillermo Lammers, 2 nd Federico Hernán Holik, 3 rd Alejandro Fernández
arxiv-2508-19276.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by 1 st Marcos Guillermo Lammers, 2 nd Federico Hernán Holik, 3 rd Alejandro Fernández. Quantum computers represent a radical technological advancement in the way information is processed by using the principles of quantum mechanics to solve very complex problems that exceed the capabilities of classical systems. However, in the current NISQ era (Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum devices), the available hardware presents several limitations, such as a limited number of qubits, high error rates, and reduced coherence times.

arxiv-2509-01221.title: DaMoC: Efficiently Selecting the Optimal Large Language Model for Fine-tuning Domain Tasks Based on Data and Model Compression
arxiv-2509-01221.creator: Wei Huang, Huang Wei, Yinggui Wang Ant Group, China{hw378176,lingxin.hw}@antgroup.com, wyinggui@gmail.com
arxiv-2509-01221.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) excel in general tasks but struggle with domain-specific ones, requiring fine-tuning with specific data. With many open-source LLMs available, selecting the best model for fine-tuning downstream tasks is challenging, primarily focusing on how to quickly identify the optimal LLM.

arxiv-2510-01634.title: CAT: Curvature-Adaptive Transformers for Geometry-Aware Learning
arxiv-2510-01634.creator: Ryan Y. Lin, Siddhartha Ojha, Nicholas Z. Bai
arxiv-2510-01634.description: Abstract Transformers achieve strong performance across diverse domains but implicitly assume Euclidean geometry in their attention mechanisms, limiting their effectiveness on data with non-Euclidean structure. While recent extensions to hyperbolic and spherical spaces show promise for hierarchical and cyclical patterns, respectively, they require committing to a single geometry a priori, reducing flexibility when data exhibits mixed geometric properties.

arxiv-2512-05562.title: Neutrino masses, 𝜹 𝐏𝐌𝐍𝐒 \delta_{\mathrm{PMNS}} , and 𝒎 𝜷 ​ 𝜷 m_{\beta\beta} in SO(10)
arxiv-2512-05562.creator: Qaisar Shafi
arxiv-2512-05562.description: Abstract We explore the leptonic sector of a recently proposed supersymmetric SO(10) model with supersymmetry breaking in the 3-10 TeV range. A new ingredient in this work is the requirement that the observed baryon asymmetry is explained via non-thermal leptogenesis, which can be realized in a large class of supersymmetric hybrid inflation models including SO(10).

pmc-10599511.title: An updated meta-analysis investigating the association between DNMTs gene polymorphism andgastric cancer risk
pmc-10599511.creator: Yu-Long Zhang, Yu-Wei Wang, Ming-Jie He, Jian-Lan Chang
pmc-10599511.description: Gastric cancer (GC) is a prominent global health issue, as it ranks as the fifth most prevalent type of cancer and the fourth most significant cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide. Although H. pylori is known to play a role in the development of GC, genetic factors also play a role in its onset and progression.

pmc-11343858.title: Molecular hydrogen in the N-doped LuH3 system as a possible path to superconductivity
pmc-11343858.creator: Cesare Tresca, Pietro Maria Forcella, Andrea Angeletti, Luigi Ranalli, Cesare Franchini, Michele Reticcioli, Gianni Profeta
pmc-11343858.description: The discovery of ambient superconductivity would mark an epochal breakthrough long-awaited for over a century, potentially ushering in unprecedented scientific and technological advancements. The recent findings on high-temperature superconducting phases in various hydrides under high pressure have ignited optimism, suggesting that the realization of near-ambient superconductivity might be on the horizon.

pmc-11440436.title: Designer pseudopeptides: autofluorescent polygonal tubes via Phe-zipper and triple helix†
pmc-11440436.creator: V. Haridas, Govind P. Maurya, Souvik Dutta
pmc-11440436.description: Chemists are increasingly turning to biology for inspiration to develop novel and superior synthetic materials. Here, we present an innovative peptide design strategy for tubular assembly. In this simple design, a phenylene urea unit is introduced as an aglet at the N-terminus of the peptide.

pmc-11471537.title: Beyond the hype: A TAM-based analysis of blockchain adoption drivers in construction industry
pmc-11471537.creator: Waeal J. Obidallah, Waleed Rashideh, Ahmed Mohammed Kamaruddeen, Taher Alzahrani, Yousef Alduraywish, Abdulaziz Alsahli, Nuha Alshuqayran
pmc-11471537.description: In complementing our existing knowledge of blockchain technology adoption in the construction industry, this research investigated how the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) applies to adopting blockchain technology among Saudi Arabian Construction companies. This study utilized cross-sectional data collection, causal research design, a quantitative research approach, and a simple random sampling technique to collect data from 248 Saudi Arabian construction companies.

pmc-11498240.title: Effect of platelet-rich fibrin and concentrated growth factor on the regenerative potential of human-induced pluripotent stem cells: A comparative analysis
pmc-11498240.creator: Ramesh Bharti, Anisha, Aseem Prakash Tikku, Promila Verma, Rakesh Kumar Yadav, Aditya Bhushan Pant
pmc-11498240.description: Background:Platelet-rich fibrin (PRF) has been used, while concentrated growth factor (CGF) has recently evolved as a bioscaffold in regenerative endodontics.Aims:This study aimed to evaluate the effect of PRF and CGF on the proliferation, migration, and differentiation of human-induced pluripotent stem cells (hiPSCs).Materials and Methods:CGF and PRF were fabricated from voluntarily donated human blood, and a conditioned medium was prepared.

pmc-11545317.title: Retrospective Radiographic Analysis of Peri-Implant Bone Loss in Mandibular Full-Arch Implant Rehabilitations
pmc-11545317.creator: Francesco Giordano, Alfonso Acerra, Roberta Gasparro, Marzio Galdi, Francesco D’Ambrosio, Mario Caggiano, Andreas Kjaer, Giuseppina Malcangi
pmc-11545317.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Objectives: Can the type of implant rehabilitation influence peri-implant bone loss in case of full-arch mandibular prosthesis? The purpose of the study was to assess, using orthopantomograms (OPGs), the bone loss around implants in different types of implant-supported prosthetic rehabilitations and identify potential risk factors, associated with the number and location of implants, that may have an association with bone defects. Methods: A radiographic study was conducted on 22,317 OPGs from 2010 to 2024.

pmc-12429261.title: Comparison of Current International Guidelines for the Management of Alopecia Areata—Comprehensive Review
pmc-12429261.creator: Julia Kropidłowska, Alexandra Kvinen, Miłosz Lewandowski, Roman J Nowicki, Wioletta Barańska-Rybak, Jong-Hyuk Sung
pmc-12429261.description: Alopecia areata is a persistent autoimmune-mediated disease with a complicated pathophysiology and a prevalence of approximately 2%. The exact pathogenesis is yet to be identified; nevertheless, environmental factors, autoimmune mechanisms and genetic factors among others all contribute to the multifactorial etiopathogenesis of the disease.

pmc-12498368.title: Biomedical dominance and the underrepresentation of primary care: An analyses of self-claimed research priorities of German medical schools
pmc-12498368.creator: Frank Müller, Eva Hummers, Eva Maria Noack
pmc-12498368.description: BackgroundPrimary care providers deliver the majority of medical care serving as essential first points of contact and care coordinators. Despite the significant challenges they face, primary care research seems to lag behind and stay low-funded. Since the mid-1990s, academic reforms have emphasised metrics like third-party funding and high-impact publications.

pmc-13132371.title: A CD138+ tumor-associated macrophage/Siglec-F+ neutrophil feed-forward loop promotes immune evasion in pancreatic cancer
pmc-13132371.creator: Chao Wang, Qi Zhang, Jinyan Huang, Fangyu Lin, Danyang Zhao, Youling Mu, Junshuo Tong, Jinping Li, Yingjiqiong Liang, Tao Zeng, Fukang Shi, Hang Shen, Tingting Lu, Tingbo Liang
pmc-13132371.description: Immune evasion is a major obstacle in pancreatic cancer therapy. Recent data implicate proinflammatory macrophages in the progression of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) and its therapeutic response. However, whether or which of the proinflammatory macrophage subtypes play a crucial role in the immune escape of PDAC remains unclear.

pmc-13434815.title: Outcomes from the NHS-Galleri trial: the good, the bad, and the uncertain
pmc-13434815.creator: Nitzan Rosenfeld
pmc-13434815.description: ew of them. Cancer can develop over many years, from cellular and then tissue abnormalities into symptomatic disease, which at that point is often lethal or incurable. We don’t always know if what looks like early cancer will become lethal, or conversely if we find it early whether we can still cure it.

pmc-13550645.title: Plasmon-induced indirect charge transfer and vibronic stabilization in 4-nitrobenzenethiol
pmc-13550645.creator: Hyoungchul Ham, Jaeyoung Jeong, Zee Hwan Kim, Myounwoo Kim, Jin Yong Lee
pmc-13550645.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Plasmon-driven reduction of 4-nitrobenzenethiol (4-NBT) has been linked experimentally to transient negative ions and nonthermal multiquantum vibrational excitation, yet the molecular nature of the electronically excited anionic state involved in this process remains unclear. Here, we present a time-dependent density functional theory (TD-DFT) study of the Au5−4-NBT complex to examine how hot-electron injection accesses a low-lying excited anionic manifold and how these states couple to vibrational motion.

pmc-13602214.title: Friday again: Timing and referral patterns of acute radiotherapy in a tertiary supraregional care network
pmc-13602214.creator: J Knoth, E Suvajac, G Altorjai, V Dick, D Kauer-Dorner, F Eckert, M Heilmann, H Herrmann, M Hudelist-Venz, S Konrad, V Potkrajcic, T Mrva-Ghukasyan, IM Simek, V Stanisav, A Sturdza, C Thiele, L Ulbrich, C Waldstein, A Zaharie, J Widder, MP Schmid
pmc-13602214.description: PurposeAcute radiotherapy is essential in oncological emergencies, but delays may occur before or after referral to radiation oncology. The primary aim of this study was to characterize timing intervals in a tertiary supraregional care network.MethodsThis retrospective single-centre analysis included patients treated with acute radiotherapy for urgent tumour-related symptoms at our department between 2009 and 2024.

pmc-13612347.title: Associated diagnostic spectrum and stratified characteristics of patients with eosinophilia: a retrospective study
pmc-13612347.creator: Dongyu He, Junyi Ke, Lan Yang, Jiaxuan Wu, Jianyue Peng, Lei Li, Weimin Li
pmc-13612347.description: BackgroundPeripheral blood eosinophilia occurs in diverse clinical conditions, including allergic diseases, infections, autoimmune disorders, hematologic malignancies, and solid malignancies. Although parasitic infection and allergic disease have traditionally been regarded as common settings, the distribution of associated diagnoses may differ in real-world tertiary-care practice.
